opening.argument: Forsage is promoted as a way to earn Ethereum daily with “zero risk” and unlimited income potential. Viewers are urged to deposit cryptocurrency, activate matrix slots, and join through a specific Forsage URL to earn more. The pitch ties greater income to buying more or higher-priced slots, explicitly claiming that each successive slot costs twice as much and generates twice the income. These claims establish a deceptive solicitation to pay into a tiered matrix earning scheme. The later qualification that income is not guaranteed and requires effort conflicts with the promotional promises; it does not remove them.
